system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (realized record, ~3-5-year window)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. The outcome window is fixed at the entity's
> fiscal-year-2018 annual report (Form 10-K filed 2019-02-22, for the year ended
> December 31, 2018) — approximately four years after the ~2014 reference point, within
> the fixed 3-5-year window. This sub-dossier contains no information about the entity's
> closing-era structure.

## Public-reporting status in the outcome window
- The entity remained a public SEC registrant and continued filing annual reports; the
  Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2018 was filed on 2019-02-22. [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]

## Realized financial record (best-documented scalars)
- Net earnings attributable to shareholders were $618,199 thousand for 2018, up from
  $489,345 thousand for 2017 and $430,807 thousand for 2016. [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018), consolidated statements of earnings]
- Total revenues were $8,138,365 thousand for 2018, versus $6,920,948 thousand (2017)
  and $6,098,037 thousand (2016). [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018), consolidated statements of earnings]
- Diluted earnings attributable to shareholders per share were $3.48. [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]
- The entity reported "no long-term debt at December 31, 2018." [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]

## Scale and organizational record
- The entity had "approximately 17,500 employees" and provided "a complete range of
  global logistics services to a diversified group of customers." [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]
- The entity leased and maintained "approximately 490 locations worldwide, of which
  approximately 100 are in the United States." [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]

## Product/process and process/organization interface record
- The entity stated it "operates the same transportation and accounting systems, running
  on a common hardware platform, in all of our full-service locations," and contrasted
  this with "competitors, who have tended to grow by merger and acquisition." [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]
- On growth mode, the entity stated it "often concluded over the course of our history
  that it is better to grow organically rather than by acquisition," and that when
  acquisitions were made "it has generally been to obtain technology, geographic coverage
  or specialized industry expertise that could be leveraged to benefit our entire
  network," while remaining "not opposed to acquisitions." [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]
- Goodwill was carried at $7,927 thousand, unchanged year over year; the entity performed
  "goodwill annual impairment test during the fourth quarter and determined that no
  impairment had occurred." [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]

## Items noted but not documented
- No divestiture, asset write-down, impairment, restructuring, or acquisition-integration
  disruption is documented in the FY2018 annual report for the outcome window; the record
  shows continued operation on a single unified operating platform with no such event
  disclosed. [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Within the fixed 3-5-year window the entity remained an independent public registrant
  operating on one unified transportation/accounting platform across ~490 locations, grew
  headcount to ~17,500 employees, carried no long-term debt, held goodwill flat with no
  impairment, and recorded rising net earnings attributable to shareholders ($430,807
  thousand for 2016, $489,345 thousand for 2017, $618,199 thousand for 2018) on total
  revenues of $8,138,365 thousand in 2018 — with no divestiture, write-down, or
  integration-disruption event disclosed. [SRC: SEC accession 0000746515-19-000004, Form 10-K (FY2018)]

[SLICE END]
